heading: Beautiful beaches, colourful art and great food
intro: Your next Caribbean adventure is just around the corner.

items.title: Beaches
items.text: Jan Thiel and Mambo Beach are minutes away — calm turquoise water, easy snorkelling and laid-back beach clubs.
items.imageAlt: Palm-lined beach with turquoise water in Curaçao

items.title: Food & drink
items.text: From beachside grills to Willemstad's waterfront restaurants, the island eats and drinks remarkably well.
items.imageAlt: Cold local beers and a hibiscus flower on a sunny terrace table

items.title: Art & culture
items.text: Wander the colourful streets of Willemstad — a UNESCO-listed capital full of murals and Dutch-Caribbean colour.
items.imageAlt: Colourful street lined with shops and greenery
